## 2024-05-24 - Prevent XSS in QR Code Rendering
**Vulnerability:** The application used `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` to render an SVG string generated by the `qrcode-generator` library for sharing links.
**Learning:** Pairing `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with dynamically generated SVG content, even from seemingly safe local data like URLs, introduces Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) risks if the input data or library behavior ever allows injection of malicious tags (like `<script>`).
**Prevention:** Always use safe rendering methods like `<img src={...} />` with Base64 data URLs (`createDataURL()`) instead of injecting raw SVG markup into the DOM.
